# Sprint bk-1 — hook registration and cron schedule stores closure_type `contract`; target_boundary `BOUNDARY-HookRegistrationStore`, `BOUNDARY-CronScheduleStore` (atm-storage, new; rusqlite implementations) and the six hook and cron error codes; branch `sprint/bk-1-hook-stores`, PR → `integrate/phase-bk`; difficulty normal; recommended_agent `arch-ctm`, recommended_model `gpt-5-codex` (normal tier). Governing text: `design.md` §4, §9.1, §9.7, D-5, D-7, D-8, D-9, D-i; anchors ANC-002, ANC-018, ANC-020, ANC-023, REQ-BK-SCHEMA. Requirements `REQ-P-HOOK-001` §23.2, `REQ-P-CRON-001` §24.1; ADR-068 D1, D5, ADR-069 D1, D4, ADR-061 D3 and D6 (record of 2026-10-18 already on this branch), ADR-063 D3 as amended by ADR-069 D5 (fourteen capabilities; Rand round 5: "yes, we need storage for cron"). Rand (2026-10-18): "error codes need to move to bk-1". ## Scope boundary This sprint owns the two storage capabilities every other sprint reads or writes through, and the error codes they and every later sprint raise: the store traits, their row and id types, the in-memory doubles, the rusqlite implementations and DDL, the storage boundary manifests, the six `AtmErrorCode` variants with their mappings and docs, the `AtmError` constructors and the two budget constants. It edits no file under `crates/atm-core`, `crates/atm-http-runtime`, `crates/atm-daemon-bootstrap` or `crates/atm`; the core hook types, the sealed traits, the routes and the protocol variants are bk-2's. Owned paths (new unless marked edited): - `crates/atm-storage/src/hook_registration_store.rs`, `crates/atm-storage/src/cron_schedule_store.rs`, `crates/atm-storage/src/lib.rs` (edited: two `pub mod` + re-exports), `crates/atm-storage/src/factory.rs` (edited: two handles on `StorageHandleParts`/`StorageHandles` + accessors `hook_registration_store()` and `cron_schedule_store()` next to `task_store()`, `factory.rs:246`), `crates/atm-storage/src/testing.rs` (edited: the in-memory doubles behind `feature = "test-utils"`), `crates/atm-storage/src/error.rs` (edited: the six constructors of `design.md` §9.1 and the three `is_validation` arms, `error.rs:102`), `crates/atm-storage/src/error_catalog.rs` (edited: guidance arms; empty for `HookRefused`), `crates/atm-storage/src/request_budget.rs` (edited: `HOOK_TIMEOUT_MAX_MS`, `CRON_TIMEOUT_MAX_MS`, `HOOK_ACTION_RESERVE_MS` after `SERVER_REQUEST_BUDGET`, `:44`), `crates/atm-storage/tests/hook_stores_contract.rs` - `crates/atm-error/src/error_codes.rs` (edited: six variants, code strings, `from_str` arms), `crates/atm-error/src/lib.rs` (edited: the six codes in the wire round-trip test tables, about `:55-110`), `docs/atm-error-codes.md` (edited: `### 5.11 Task Hooks And Cron`, one `#### 5.11.n` per code, six `## 7.1` rows) - `crates/atm-storage-rusqlite/src/hook_registration_store.rs`, `crates/atm-storage-rusqlite/src/cron_schedule_store.rs`, `crates/atm-storage-rusqlite/src/hook_schema.rs`, `crates/atm-storage-rusqlite/src/shared_db.rs` (edited: one `ensure_schema` call in the line-654 block), `crates/atm-storage-rusqlite/src/lib.rs` (edited: mods + factory wiring at `impl StorageFactory for SqliteStorageFactory`, line 774), `crates/atm-storage-rusqlite/tests/hook_registration_store.rs`, `crates/atm-storage-rusqlite/tests/cron_schedule_store.rs`, `crates/atm-storage-rusqlite/tests/hook_schema.rs` - `boundaries/atm-storage/hook-registration-store.toml`, `boundaries/atm-storage/cron-schedule-store.toml`, `boundaries/atm-storage-rusqlite/hook-registration-store-sqlite.toml`, `boundaries/atm-storage-rusqlite/cron-schedule-store-sqlite.toml` (format of `boundaries/atm-storage/task-store.toml` and `task-store-sqlite.toml`) - `docs/atm-storage/boundaries.md` (edited: `## HookRegistrationStore` and `## CronScheduleStore` after `## TaskStore`), `docs/adr/ADR-036-*.md` (one amendment paragraph, format of its Phase AQ amendment, naming the two capabilities under ADR-069 D5), `docs/adr/ADR-063-*.md` (edited: the two pointer phrases "(amended to fourteen by ADR-069 D5)" at `:112` and `:186`, nothing else) ## Public contract ```rust // crates/atm-storage/src/hook_registration_store.rs #[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, PartialOrd, Ord, Serialize, Deserialize)] #[serde(try_from = "String", into = "String")] pub struct HookName(String); // the eight names: task.assign|task.start|task.close|task.move|task.list|task.events|cron.tick|cron.stop impl HookName { pub const TASK_HOOKS: [&'static str; 6] = ["task.assign", "task.start", "task.close", "task.move", "task.list", "task.events"]; pub const CRON_TICK: &'static str = "cron.tick"; pub const CRON_STOP: &'static str = "cron.stop"; pub fn parse(name: &str) -> Result; // any of the eight, else AtmError::hook_malformed("unknown hook name ") pub fn parse_task_hook(name: &str) -> Result; // exactly TASK_HOOKS, else AtmError::hook_module_invalid(..) (the register route's only validator, ADR-068 D3) pub fn as_str(&self) -> &str; } impl TryFrom for HookName { type Error = AtmError; } // via parse impl From for String {} impl std::fmt::Display for HookName {} #[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, PartialOrd, Ord, Serialize, Deserialize)] #[serde(try_from = "String", into = "String")] pub struct PhaseId(String); // ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}$, checked with std char tests, no regex crate impl PhaseId { pub fn parse(s: &str) -> Result; pub fn as_str(&self) -> &str; } // Err is AtmError::validation naming the grammar impl TryFrom for PhaseId { type Error = AtmError; } impl From for String {} impl std::fmt::Display for PhaseId {} #[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)] pub struct HookRegistration { pub team: TeamName, pub phase: PhaseId, pub hook: HookName, pub module_path: PathBuf, pub cwd: PathBuf, pub timeout_ms: u32, pub custom: serde_json::Map, // registration-time custom JSON object (Rand 2026-10-18, design.md §2.1) pub active: bool, pub registered_by: AgentName, pub registered_at: IsoTimestamp, pub disabled_at: Option, } pub trait HookRegistrationStore: crate::contract::sealed::Sealed + Send + Sync { // sealed like TemplateCatalogStore (contract.rs:16) /// Upsert on (team, phase, hook); other phases' rows are untouched, any number may be active (D-5). fn register(&self, registration: HookRegistration) -> Result; /// Sets active = 0 and disabled_at = now on the ACTIVE rows of (team, phase), or the one hook; an inactive row keeps its earlier disabled_at. /// Returns only the rows it changed; empty when none were active. fn disable(&self, team: &TeamName, phase: &PhaseId, hook: Option<&HookName>) -> Result, AtmError>; /// Every active row for (team, hook), one per phase, ordered by registered_at then phase (D-5). fn active(&self, team: &TeamName, hook: &HookName) -> Result, AtmError>; /// Every row of the team (doctor, `atm hook list`); phase filter optional. fn list(&self, team: &TeamName, phase: Option<&PhaseId>) -> Result, AtmError>; /// Every active row of every team: the router's in-memory snapshot source (design D-8). fn active_all(&self) -> Result, AtmError>; } // crates/atm-storage/src/testing.rs (feature test-utils; re-exported by atm-runtime-test-support in bk-2) pub struct InMemoryHookRegistrationStore { rows: Mutex>, pub calls: AtomicUsize } // calls counts every trait call (ANC-014 proof) // crates/atm-storage/src/cron_schedule_store.rs #[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, PartialOrd, Ord, Serialize, Deserialize)] #[serde(transparent)] pub struct CronScheduleId(pub u64); // Display prints the integer #[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)] pub struct CronSchedule { pub id: CronScheduleId, pub team: TeamName, pub phase: PhaseId, pub name: String, pub cron_expr: String, pub module_path: PathBuf, pub cwd: PathBuf, pub args: Vec, pub timeout_ms: u32, pub jitter_s: u32, pub custom: serde_json::Map, pub stop: StopCondition, pub active: bool, pub created_by: AgentName, pub created_at: IsoTimestamp, pub last_run_at: Option, pub last_outcome: Option, pub ended_at: Option, } /// design.md D-9, ADR-069 D4: exactly one per schedule; `Until` maps to the `until_at` column, `Hook` to `stop_hook = 1`. #[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)] #[serde(tag = "kind", rename_all = "snake_case")] pub enum StopCondition { Until { at: chrono::DateTime }, Hook } #[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)] pub struct NewCronSchedule { pub team: TeamName, pub phase: PhaseId, pub name: String, pub cron_expr: String, pub module_path: PathBuf, pub cwd: PathBuf, pub args: Vec, pub timeout_ms: u32, pub jitter_s: u32, pub custom: serde_json::Map, pub stop: StopCondition, pub created_by: AgentName } // jitter_s is assigned by AtmCron::start (bk-4, design.md §5) pub trait CronScheduleStore: crate::contract::sealed::Sealed + Send + Sync { /// No row for (team, phase, name): INSERT. An ended row: UPDATE in place in one transaction, id kept, every field from `schedule`, /// active = 1, ended_at, last_run_at, last_outcome NULL (D-i). An active row: Err(AtmError::validation("cron schedule already active for phase

")). fn start(&self, schedule: NewCronSchedule) -> Result; /// Active rows only, as HookRegistrationStore::disable; returns the rows changed. fn end(&self, team: &TeamName, phase: &PhaseId, name: Option<&str>) -> Result, AtmError>; fn list(&self, team: Option<&TeamName>, phase: Option<&PhaseId>) -> Result, AtmError>; fn active_all(&self) -> Result, AtmError>; // daemon start (ANC-020) /// UPDATE ... WHERE id = ? AND active = 1; Ok(false) when the row is inactive (a run that finishes after `end` changes nothing). fn record_run(&self, id: CronScheduleId, at: IsoTimestamp, outcome: &str) -> Result; /// The stop condition fired (ADR-069 D4): active = 0, ended_at = at, last_outcome = "stopped: "; Ok(false) when already inactive. fn record_stop(&self, id: CronScheduleId, at: IsoTimestamp, reason: &str) -> Result; } pub struct InMemoryCronScheduleStore { rows: Mutex>, pub calls: AtomicUsize } // testing.rs, test-utils // crates/atm-storage/src/request_budget.rs pub const HOOK_ACTION_RESERVE_MS: u64 = 500; pub const HOOK_TIMEOUT_MAX_MS: u32 = 2500; // task hooks only: SERVER_REQUEST_BUDGET (3 s) minus the reserve; const assert ties the two pub const CRON_TIMEOUT_MAX_MS: u32 = 30000; // cron.tick / cron.stop only (Rand 2026-10-18, design.md §9.8) // crates/atm-storage/src/error.rs: the six constructors of design.md §9.1 (hook_exit, hook_timeout, hook_malformed, // hook_module_invalid, hook_refused, cron_expr_invalid); is_validation true for HookModuleInvalid, CronExprInvalid, HookRefused. // crates/atm-storage-rusqlite: pub(crate)-constructed, private outside the crate, exactly as SqliteTaskStore (task-store-sqlite.toml) pub(crate) struct SqliteHookRegistrationStore { db: SharedDb } // register: INSERT OR REPLACE on (team, phase, hook) pub(crate) struct SqliteCronScheduleStore { db: SharedDb } // start: the UNIQUE and CHECK constraints map to AtmError::validation naming the constraint ``` `atm-error` variants: `HookModuleInvalid => "ATM_HOOK_MODULE_INVALID"`, `CronExprInvalid => "ATM_CRON_EXPR_INVALID"`, `HookRefused => "ATM_HOOK_REFUSED"`, `HookExit => "ATM_HOOK_EXIT"`, `HookTimeout => "ATM_HOOK_TIMEOUT"`, `HookMalformed => "ATM_HOOK_MALFORMED"`. Status, class and messages are `design.md` §9.1; the HTTP status is 400 or 503, never 500. DDL (`hook_schema.rs`, run from `ensure_schema`, `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS` like `prompt_handoffs`): ```sql CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS hook_registration ( team TEXT NOT NULL, phase TEXT NOT NULL, hook TEXT NOT NULL, module_path TEXT NOT NULL, cwd TEXT NOT NULL, timeout_ms INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(timeout_ms > 0), custom TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(active IN (0, 1)), registered_by TEXT NOT NULL, registered_at TEXT NOT NULL, disabled_at TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (team, phase, hook)); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cron_schedule ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, team TEXT NOT NULL, phase TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, cron_expr TEXT NOT NULL, module_path TEXT NOT NULL, cwd TEXT NOT NULL, args TEXT NOT NULL, timeout_ms INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(timeout_ms > 0), jitter_s INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(jitter_s >= 0), custom TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(active IN (0, 1)), until_at TEXT NULL, stop_hook INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(stop_hook IN (0, 1)), created_by TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, last_run_at TEXT NULL, last_outcome TEXT NULL, ended_at TEXT NULL, CHECK ((until_at IS NOT NULL) + (stop_hook = 1) = 1), UNIQUE (team, phase, name)); ``` `args` is a JSON array string and `custom` a JSON object string (`serde_json::to_string` of the map; a stored value that is not an object is an `AtmError` naming the row); `until_at` is RFC 3339 UTC text; the last CHECK enforces design D-9 (exactly one stop condition). Both tables are additive SQLite MINOR objects (ADR-061 D1): no foreign key, created idempotently, ignored by a pre-bk binary. There is no database-wide schema version constant; the previous-consumer proof is the pre-bk DDL test below. ## Authoritative deliverables 1. `atm-storage`: the traits, rows, ids and `StopCondition` above, both traits sealed with `crate::contract::sealed::Sealed`; the in-memory doubles in `atm_storage::testing` behind `feature = "test-utils"` with a call counter; `StorageHandleParts`/`StorageHandles` gain the two handles and accessors next to `task_store()` (`factory.rs:246`); the two budget constants. 2. Errors: the six `AtmErrorCode` variants, their `is_validation` arms, catalog guidance, constructors and `docs/atm-error-codes.md` §5.11 and §7.1 rows exactly as `design.md` §9.1. 3. `atm-storage-rusqlite`: `hook_schema.rs` DDL wired into `ensure_schema` (`shared_db.rs:654` block, after `task_store::ensure_schema`, one line); `SqliteHookRegistrationStore` and `SqliteCronScheduleStore` on the shared writer connection, `pub(crate)`-constructed and private outside the crate exactly as `SqliteTaskStore`; `SqliteStorageFactory::open` (`lib.rs:774`) composes both. `StopCondition::Until { at }` is stored as `until_at` RFC 3339 text with `stop_hook = 0`, `Hook` as `until_at NULL`, `stop_hook = 1`. Rows persist across reopen. 4. Boundary manifests for the four store boundaries: `io_forbidden` includes `process_spawn` on both traits; the two `atm-storage` manifests list `allowed_test_double_paths = ["crate::testing::InMemoryHookRegistrationStore"]` / `["crate::testing::InMemoryCronScheduleStore"]` and `allowed_dependents = ["atm-core", "atm-daemon-bootstrap", "atm-runtime", "atm-runtime-test-support", "atm-storage-rusqlite"]` (no `atm-cron`: that crate reaches the stores only through `atm_core::boundary`); the rusqlite manifests `constructor = "pub(crate)"`, `visibility = "private"`. `docs/atm-storage/boundaries.md` gains the two sections, ADR-036 the amendment paragraph and ADR-063 the two pointer phrases. 5. Tests, same unit, in the files named by each criterion below. New logic lives in new files; `.just/check_line_counts.py` passes. ## Authoritative acceptance criteria - [ ] (ANC-002) `boundary:BOUNDARY-HookRegistrationStore` `crates/atm-storage-rusqlite/tests/hook_registration_store.rs::disable_keeps_rows_inactive`: `disable(team, phase, None)` leaves the rows present with `active == false` and `disabled_at` set; `active(team, hook)` then returns `None`; `list` still returns them. - [ ] (D-5) `boundary:BOUNDARY-HookRegistrationStore` `hook_registration_store.rs::register_second_phase_same_hook_succeeds`: registering `task.close` for phase `bk` while phase `bj`'s `task.close` is active succeeds, both stay active, and `active(team, task.close)` returns `[bj, bk]` in `registered_at` order; `disable(bj)` leaves `[bk]`. - [ ] `boundary:BOUNDARY-HookRegistrationStore` `hook_registration_store.rs::disable_twice_keeps_first_disabled_at` and `::disable_phase_with_no_rows_returns_empty`: a second `disable` returns `[]` and the row's `disabled_at` is unchanged; `disable` of a phase with no rows returns `[]`. - [ ] (ADR-068 D3) `boundary:BOUNDARY-HookRegistrationStore` `crates/atm-storage/tests/hook_stores_contract.rs::hook_name_parse_sets`: `parse_task_hook` accepts exactly the six task names and refuses `cron.tick`, `cron.stop` and `task.foo` with `ATM_HOOK_MODULE_INVALID`; `parse` accepts all eight and refuses `task.foo` with `ATM_HOOK_MALFORMED`; `::hook_name_deserialize_rejects_unknown` shows `serde_json::from_str::("\"task.foo\"")` is `Err`. - [ ] `boundary:BOUNDARY-HookRegistrationStore` `hook_stores_contract.rs::phase_id_rejects_empty_uppercase_space_and_newline`: `PhaseId::parse` accepts `bk`, `bk-2`, a 32-character id, and refuses `""`, `Bk`, `b k`, `bk\n`, `2bk` and a 33-character id. - [ ] (ANC-011) `boundary:BOUNDARY-HookRegistrationStore` `hook_registration_store.rs::zero_timeout_fails_the_check`: `HookRegistration.timeout_ms` is `u32` and the DDL `CHECK(timeout_ms > 0)` rejects `0`; `HOOK_TIMEOUT_MAX_MS == 2500` and `HOOK_ACTION_RESERVE_MS == 500` (the module value is read by bk-5). - [ ] (Rand 2026-10-18 cron rulings) `boundary:BOUNDARY-CronScheduleStore` `cron_schedule_store.rs::jitter_and_custom_round_trip`: a schedule started with `jitter_s = 1799` and `custom = {"goal":"x","n":[1,{"y":null}]}` reads back from `list` and from `active_all()` on a reopened backend with both equal; `CRON_TIMEOUT_MAX_MS == 30000`; `hook_registration_store.rs::custom_round_trips_and_defaults_to_empty_object` stores a registration's `custom` and reads it back equal, and a row inserted by SQL without `custom` reads back as an empty map. - [ ] (D-8) `boundary:BOUNDARY-HookRegistrationStore` `hook_stores_contract.rs::active_all_spans_teams_and_counts_calls`: `active_all()` returns the active rows of two teams and omits disabled rows; `InMemoryHookRegistrationStore.calls` counts the call. - [ ] (ANC-018, ANC-020) `boundary:BOUNDARY-CronScheduleStore` `crates/atm-storage-rusqlite/tests/cron_schedule_store.rs::active_all_survives_reopen`: a schedule started on one backend is returned by `active_all()` on a second backend opened on the same file (the daemon-restart case: bk-4's worker loads exactly `active_all()` at daemon start), with `cron_expr` byte-identical and `stop` equal to the value started. - [ ] (ANC-023) `boundary:BOUNDARY-CronScheduleStore` `cron_schedule_store.rs::stop_condition_check_and_round_trip`: `NewCronSchedule` has no constructor without a `StopCondition`; an `INSERT` with `until_at NULL` and `stop_hook 0`, and one with both set, each fail the CHECK; `Until` round-trips as `until_at` RFC 3339 text and `Hook` as `stop_hook = 1`. - [ ] (ANC-024, ANC-025) `boundary:BOUNDARY-CronScheduleStore` `cron_schedule_store.rs::record_stop_ends_the_row_once`: `record_stop(id, t, "phase bead closed")` leaves `active == false`, `ended_at == t`, `last_outcome == "stopped: phase bead closed"` and `active_all()` omits it; a second call returns `Ok(false)` and changes nothing. - [ ] (D-i) `boundary:BOUNDARY-CronScheduleStore` `cron_schedule_store.rs::start_after_end_updates_in_place_and_keeps_the_id`: `start` of an ended name returns the same `id` with `active == true` and `ended_at`, `last_run_at`, `last_outcome` all `None`; `::start_refuses_active_duplicate` refuses a second `start` while the first is active. - [ ] `boundary:BOUNDARY-CronScheduleStore` `cron_schedule_store.rs::record_run_on_ended_row_changes_nothing`: after `end`, `record_run(id, t, "ok")` returns `Ok(false)` and `last_outcome` keeps its value. - [ ] (REQ-BK-SCHEMA) `boundary:BOUNDARY-SharedDb-Sqlite` `crates/atm-storage-rusqlite/tests/hook_schema.rs::pre_bk_ddl_set_reads_and_writes_after_hook_tables_created`: both tables are created by `ensure_schema` on an empty database and on a database created by the pre-bk `DB_MIGRATIONS` string; the frozen pre-bk statements still read and write afterwards (pattern `pre_bb_ddl_set_reads_and_writes_after_prompt_handoffs_created`). - [ ] (REQ-BK-ERRORS) `boundary:BOUNDARY-AtmErrorCodes` `crates/atm-error/src/lib.rs` round-trip tables carry the six codes through `as_str`/`from_str`; `crates/atm-storage/src/error.rs::tests::hook_error_constructors_format_and_classify` asserts each §9.1 message, `is_validation` true for exactly the three validation codes, and that `hook_refused("bd not ready")` displays exactly `bd not ready` with no `Recovery:` line; `docs/atm-error-codes.md` lists each code once in §5.11 and once in §7.1. - [ ] `boundary:BOUNDARY-HookRegistrationStore` both store traits are sealed, their doubles are compiled only under `test-utils`, the two `atm-storage` manifests list each double as the sole test double, the rusqlite types are not constructible outside their crate; `just lint` boundary check passes with the four manifests. - [ ] `boundary:BOUNDARY-SharedDb-Sqlite` `docs/atm-storage/boundaries.md` has one section per new store; ADR-036 names both under ADR-069 D5; ADR-063's only change is the two pointer phrases (`git diff` of that file shows two changed lines). ## Authoritative validation - `cargo build --workspace` - `cargo test -p atm-storage --features test-utils -p atm-storage-rusqlite -p atm-error` - `cargo clippy -p atm-storage -p atm-storage-rusqlite -p atm-error --all-targets -- -D warnings` - `just lint` (boundary manifests, `.just/check_line_counts.py`, RULE-003) ## Non-closure - No core hook type, sealed trait, route or protocol variant (bk-2: `HookRequest`, `HookReply`, `StopReply`, `HookAction`, `HookRunner`, `CronScheduler`, `HookActionDispatcher`, the twelve envelope variants); no hook process is spawned (bk-3); no tick fires (bk-4); no CLI command, `TIMEOUT_MS` read, exit-code arm or doctor section (bk-5). - `LocalServiceRuntime` accessors and the `atm-runtime` composition of the two stores are bk-2's.
title: hook registration and cron schedule stores
